# Hard-coded valid Item = Sku pairs, matching the intended VBA logic.
valid_pairs = {
    ("RPC0094", "17343D"),
    ("RPC0097", "17263D"),

}

header_row = 1

item_col = headers["Item"]
sku_col = headers["Sku"]

# Determine last real data row in the allowed target columns A:F.
last_row = header_row
for r in range(ws.max_row, header_row, -1):
    if any(ws.cell(r, c).value is not None for c in range(1, 7)):
        last_row = r
        break

# Delete rows whose Item/Sku pair is not in the hard-coded list.
# Work bottom-up so row numbers remain valid after deletion.
for r in range(last_row, header_row, -1):
    item = ws.cell(r, item_col).value

from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/94-8/1_94-8_input.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["BeforeVBA"]

# Hard-coded allowed Item = Sku pairs, equivalent to the VBA dictionary/list.
allowed_pairs = {
    ("RPC0094", "17343D"),
    ("RPC0097", "17263D"),
    ("RPC0068", "17232B"),
}

# Locate the Item and Sku columns from the header row so the code is not tied
# to fixed column letters if the exported file keeps the same headers in a
# different order.
headers = {}
for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
    val = ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value
    if val is not None:
        headers[str(val)] = col

item_col = headers.get("Item")
sku_col = headers.get("Sku")

if item_col is None or sku_col is None:
    raise ValueError("Could not find required 'Item' and 'Sku' columns.")

# Determine the real last data row using the populated area in columns A:F.
last_data_row = 1
for row in range(ws.max_row, 1, -1):
    if any(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value is not None for col in range(1, 7)):
        last_data_row = row
        break

# Delete non-matching rows from bottom to top, mirroring the intended VBA row deletion.
for row in range(last_data_row, 1, -1):
    item_value = ws.cell(row=row, column=item_col).value
    sku_value = ws.cell(row=row, column=sku_col).value

    if (item_value, sku_value) not in allowed_pairs:
        ws.delete_rows(row, 1)

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
